thread:
kate: FYI — prospect wants EU-only POC next Tue. They insist: inference, logs, metrics & debug dumps must remain in EU. Need one-paragraph SOW line + short checklist.

jon: Quick SOW line: "All request payloads, model inputs/outputs and per-request logs will be stored and processed only within EU regions. Aggregated non-identifiable product telemetry may be processed outside the EU unless a Dedicated or Private deployment is selected, in which case telemetry will be scoped to the EU."

meera: Legal note: we can provide SCCs and a current subprocessor list for presales. Formal attestation (signed vendor artifacts) takes vendor pulls ~10-15 business days. Add that sentence to SOW.

jon: Implementation notes for sales (paste-ready):
- Deployment choices: Hosted (fast, routing pref only) or Dedicated (EU-only, VPC+BOSH, BYOK support).
- egress_policy: reject (reject requests if EU capacity exhausted) or nearest (allow non-EU fallback).
- If setting reject, runtime returns 429/503 on capacity shortage.
- Deliverables needed: completed security questionnaire, PO contact, BYOK yes/no, approved subproc list.

ops-bot: INC-11900 created for EU Dedicated warmup. Typical warmup 48-72h after approval.

infra: For SOW clarity use exact phrase: "Requests will be rejected when EU capacity is unavailable if egress_policy is set to 'reject'." Also confirm whether customer requires request-level encryption keys.

kate: Great — I'll send the checklist + subproc link and flag the attestation timeline. Tagging @meera for kickoff once sales confirms.
